test.name: Unsound-premise guard on an empty research log: the compiled source shows only in the tree's source title
test.description: flynn-unsourced-tree-empty-log is 008's scenario with the research log emptied: no sources, assertions, person_evidence or hypotheses, and an objective that states no doubt. The Thomas Flynn parentage rests only on the tree's S1, an Ancestry Member Tree, so the agent learns it is compiled only from the subjects' sources read (tree_query includeSources). The first question must verify the parentage premise. Lead decision on issue #4382, 2026-11-16.

input.delegation:
Select and record the next research question for this project.

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: Should recognize that the Thomas Flynn parentage rests on a single compiled source: the tree's only citation for it is an Ancestry Member Tree. The research log is empty, so this is visible only in the tree's source title.
Should NOT propose a question that assumes Thomas Flynn is the father (e.g., 'Did Thomas Flynn leave a will?' or 'Where was Thomas Flynn born in Ireland?') — these build on an unverified premise

Should propose a question whose purpose is to verify or corroborate the online tree claim against original records. Both broad questions ('Does original evidence confirm Thomas Flynn as Patrick's father?') AND specific record-type questions ('What does Patrick Flynn's death certificate say about his parents?', 'Does the 1850 census place Patrick Flynn in a Thomas Flynn household?') are acceptable — all three are verification questions that neither assume the claim nor build on it. The key criterion is that the question tests the claim rather than accepting it.
The rationale must cite the compiled/unsourced nature of the evidence as the reason the premise must be verified first
